description: This file manages Bluetooth device operations such as discovery, retrieval, pairing, and unpairing, interacting with a database module for persistent storage.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Simulates Bluetooth device discovery, returning a list of devices with addresses and names.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all devices associated with a user from the database.

methods.name: pair
methods.description: Adds a new device to the database for a user, recording pairing time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific device by ID for a user from the database.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Removes a device association for a user from the database.
